target: Spoiler-free 100% completion of both canons and all current Windows content

areas.name: Chosen Route and Global Completion
areas.location_cue: Title screen, opening route prompt, Da'at map, World of Shadows, Demon Haunt, and clear-data loader.
areas.note: Only physical navigation and completion mechanics are exposed; narrative identities remain hidden.

save_backup.title: Protect a separate save before continuing
save_backup.why: The two campaigns and their outcomes must feed one protected carried-clear lineage.
save_backup.detail: Keep that slot until every linked request, outcome, catalogue row, and carried record has been checked.

levels.1: Use the current native PC build.
levels.2: Launch Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance on Windows with update content installed.
levels.3: Record the game version, difficulty, owned optional add-ons, and any detected legacy-save bonus before opening a new file. The archive route needs no console replay because Windows contains the complete high-fidelity release.

levels.1: The opening choice controls which campaign ledger is active.
levels.2: Choose Canon of Creation at the opening branch and keep a separate slot.
levels.3: Select the Creation branch at the first route prompt. Do not overwrite its initial save with the other campaign: field variants, requests, encounters, outcomes, and carried trainer data must be reconciled across both branches.

levels.1: Return to the opening branch on a separate run.
levels.2: Choose Canon of Vengeance at the opening branch and keep a separate slot.
levels.3: Begin the Vengeance branch from a fresh or qualifying carried file. Keep it distinct from the Creation slot, finish its exclusive requests and field records, and preserve its clear mark for the combined Virtual Trainer ledger.

levels.2: Audit Every Leyline Fount on both route files where the record can differ.
levels.3: Open the interface that confirms Every Leyline Fount, compare it against the relevant field, inventory, compendium, Haunt, and clear-data ledgers, then retain the verified state. Discovery alone is insufficient when collection, registration, dialogue, or completion has its own recorded state.

levels.1: Check the Haunt whenever the game signals that an ally wants to talk.
levels.2: Place the matching registered ally in stock, enter a Haunt, and inspect its conversation state.
levels.3: Recruit or fuse the matching demon, keep it in stock, and enter Demon Haunt from a leyline. Clear every available speech bubble, give gifts when useful, and repeat after battles or requests until no new exchange remains. Record any item, stat increase, or maximum-trust message before dismissing it.

areas.location_cue: Store entitlement list, downloadable-content settings, request markers, and compendium.
areas.note: Only physical navigation and completion mechanics are exposed; narrative identities remain hidden.

save_backup.title: Protect a separate save before continuing
save_backup.why: Add-on encounters and registrations must be retained before the route file is replaced.
save_backup.detail: Keep that slot until every linked request, outcome, catalogue row, and carried record has been checked.

levels.1: Verify owned content before the run instead of assuming it is installed.
levels.2: Confirm the entitlement for Sakura Cinders of the East and its in-game switch or request.
levels.3: Install and enable Sakura Cinders of the East, then verify its optional encounter and fusion permission inside the game. Encounter add-ons require their optional request and resulting registration; spawn-rate modifiers require one observed qualifying spawn and may then be disabled. These paid entitlements are tracked separately from the included legacy requests.
